title: SMMU / IOMMU: 4 KB page translation with a 4-entry TLB, hardware table walk and fault reporting between AXI4 ports
features: s_* is the AXI4 subordinate port of the upstream master, m_* the AXI4 manager port downstream; both pass through unchanged.
PTE at PT_BASE + 4 * VA[31:12]: bit 0 VALID, bit 1 WRITABLE, bits 31:12 PPN; PA = {PPN, VA[11:0]}. Walks are single-beat reads with ID 15 (AxPROT 3'b010).
4-entry fully associative TLB, round-robin fill; CMD.tlb_inv empties it.

Fault (not VALID, walk error response, write to a page that is not WRITABLE): the burst is not forwarded and ends with SLVERR upstream (all W beats taken first); FAULT_ADDR = VA, FAULT_INFO = {walk_err, write, not_writable, not_valid}.
CTRL.enable 0: bypass (PA = VA). One burst at a time; reads and writes alternate when both wait.

fields.desc: byte address of the PTE of page 0
virtual address of the last faulting burst

sequence: Build the page table in memory, write PT_BASE, write CMD.tlb_inv = 1.
On a FAULT interrupt read FAULT_ADDR and FAULT_INFO, fix the table, write CMD.tlb_inv and clear IRQ_STATUS.
notes: m_* is the AXI4 manager port (32-bit address and data, 4-bit ID, no user / QoS); it passes through unchanged. Bursts are INCR, AxSIZE = 2 (4 bytes), 1 to 16 beats, WSTRB = 4'hF, never across a 4 KB boundary; one read and one write burst are outstanding at a time. A read burst is issued only when its data has room, a write burst only when all its data is ready.
